title: Spooled result files trust .boreal/results without realpath containment
description: apps/cli/src/output.ts writes oversized JSON envelopes under workspaceRoot/.boreal/results, and apps/console/src/app/live-data.ts reads fullResultPath/report artifacts after only lexical path handling. If .boreal/results is symlinked, spooled output writes and console artifact browsing can escape the workspace and read or write unintended files.
acceptanceCriteria: Spooled result writers and console result readers share a realpath containment guard for .boreal/results.
Symlinked or missing-ancestor results roots that resolve outside the workspace are rejected before writing, walking, or reading artifacts.
Regression tests prove .boreal/results symlink escapes cannot create outside result files or expose outside report artifacts.
